Jordan: Tiny ask-the-room before sign-off: if you could take one non-electronic thing to your bed tonight, what is it? keep it silly. :sleeping:
Priya: A paperback mystery. the crinkly spine is my lullaby. :book:
Lin: A ridiculous plush llama. zero practical use, maximum comfort. :llama:
Oscar: Noise-canceling earbuds? wait those are electronic. ok fine: a mug of chamomile tea. warm hands = instant zen. :tea:
Jordan: Classic. I'm voting for 'something squishy' category. pillow pet wins. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Priya: vote option: pet plant? low maintenance cuddles. :seedling:
Lin: Also bonus points if it smells like cinnamon. instantly nostalgic.
Oscar: Coffee-bot: friendly reminder: "Hydration suggestion: sip water before sleep if you've had tea." :robot_face:
coffee-bot: Tip: chamomile + one deep breath = better dreams. :herb:
Jordan: This thread is peak small-habits content. ok tomorrow I'll bring a tiny plush llama to the office for moral support. :tada:
Priya: please name it. we need lore. :sparkles:
Lin: Name suggestion: Sir Snoozington. :crown:
Oscar: Agreed. Sir Snoozington it is. good night team. :crescent_moon:
